description:
Defeat Invasion of Alara, causing you to cast Awaken the Maelstrom without paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

uses.name: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom
